name: incident-retrieval-repair
description: LU 2.11 Assignment: Fix the broken incident retrieval (pgvector) schema to match the retrieval spec

scripts.db:reset: psql -U postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS incident_retrieval_test;" && psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE incident_retrieval_test;" && psql -U postgres -d incident_retrieval_test -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgtap;" && psql -U postgres -d incident_retrieval_test -f migrations/001_retrieval_schema.sql
